title: Jogendra v. State of Uttar Pradesh
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
disposition: Writ dismissed with liberty to approach Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5.
headnote: Writ dismissed with liberty to approach the Executive Engineer under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005; any such application to be decided in accordance with law within four weeks. The Court did not adjudicate the petition on merits.
facts: The petitioner, Jogendra, filed Writ-C No. 2739 of 2026 in the Allahabad High Court against the State of Uttar Pradesh and two others. At the hearing, counsel for respondent nos. 2 and 3 submitted that the petitioner had an alternative statutory remedy under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The order does not record the nature of the underlying electricity grievance. Counsel for the petitioner, those respondents, and the Standing Counsel were present.

holding_units.holding: Where an alternative statutory remedy under Clause 6.5 of the U.P. Electricity Supply Code, 2005 is raised, the writ is dismissed with liberty to approach the Executive Engineer under that clause; any such application shall be decided in accordance with law within four weeks of production of a certified copy, and the High Court does not adjudicate the petition on merits.

not_decided.issue: Merits of the petition, which the Court expressly declined to adjudicate; the competent authority is to decide independently.
